text: The purpose of this report is to advise Toronto City Council, pursuant to Chapter 195 of the Toronto Municipal Code, Procurement, Section 195-7.5.B, of a non-competitive contract with Alberici Constructors Ltd., for the emergency roof replacement at the Humber Treatment Plant Operations and Control Centre, for a total value of $1,741,076, net of all taxes and charges ($1,771,719 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries). The issuance of this non-competitive contract was a matter of extreme urgency, as during construction, demolition revealed multiple cracks and leaks in the existing roof. Immediate action was required to protect staff health and safety, ensure uninterrupted wastewater treatment operations, limit impacts to existing contract warranties and mitigate the risk of costly future repairs.
